title_working: Ever Since He Was Five, Leo Could See When Someone Lied

lines.text: Ever since he was five, Leo could see when someone lied.
lines.say: (confident) Ever since he was five, Leo could see when someone lied.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: A liar's face flashes bright red, just for a second.
lines.say: (happy) A liar's face flashes bright red, just for a second.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: But one girl at school, Pia, turned red almost every time she spoke.
lines.say: (nervous) But one girl at school, Pia, turned red almost every time she spoke.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: I'm fine, she would say. Red. I don't need help. Red.
lines.say: (soft tone) I'm fine, she would say. Red. I don't need help. Red.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: So Leo decided she was fake, and he stayed away.
lines.say: (sad) So Leo decided she was fake, and he stayed away.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: One day, the teacher asked why her homework was missing. I forgot, she said. Red.
lines.say: (nervous) One day, the teacher asked why her homework was missing. I forgot, she said. Red.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: After school, Leo followed her home.
lines.say: (nervous) After school, Leo followed her home.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: She cooked dinner, helped her little brother with his homework, and tucked him into bed.
lines.say: (soft tone) She cooked dinner, helped her little brother with his homework, and tucked him into bed.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Their mom wasn't home. She never was.
lines.say: (sad) Their mom wasn't home. She never was.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Are you okay? her brother asked. I'm fine, she smiled. Red.
lines.say: (sad) Are you okay? her brother asked. I'm fine, she smiled. Red.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: That's when Leo understood. She wasn't fake. She was carrying everything alone.
lines.say: (soft tone) That's when Leo understood. She wasn't fake. She was carrying everything alone.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: The next morning, he sat next to her and said, you don't have to be fine.
lines.say: (happy) The next morning, he sat next to her and said, you don't have to be fine.
lines.speaker: narrator
